result.summary: Ran zig build test-integration-iss102 (8/8 tests) and a newly-added zig build test-integration-idn02 (7/7 tests) six consecutive times each against a live, freshly migrated bpm_test database — 100% pass, zero flakiness, including the two-real-OS-thread TC-ISS-102-02 concurrency test. git log shows two later, separately-tracked fixes already landed after ISS-0115 was filed (2026-08-01): ISS-0619/GH-568 (commit eea8b9f, 2026-08-08) replaced an unconditional deny in tasks.zig handleComplete Branch 3 with a live identity.canClaimGroupTask(...) check, fixing TC-IDN-02-06/07. ISS-0124/GH-390 (commit 3bc063b, 2026-08-02) fixed 15+ PostgreSQL C42883 asymmetric type-cast errors across 8 files the day after ISS-0115 was filed, from the same failing full-suite run window — the most plausible explanation for the TC-ISS-102-02/04/05/08 failures, since claimTask's atomic single-statement UPDATE ... WHERE claimed_by IS NULL AND status='PENDING' RETURNING ... CAS was already correct at filing time and a C42883 error surfaces identically to a logic defect on first read. Conclusion: root cause already resolved on main; no production code change needed.
